info.name: Ambigo V2 Backend API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Ambigo V2 Go backend.

## Authentication
- **API Key**: All requests (except /metrics, /health, /ws, /webhook) require `X-API-Key` header
- **JWT Bearer**: Protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`
- **Roles**: `user`, `driver`, `unvrf_driver`, `admin`

## Base URL
`{{base_url}}` defaults to `http://localhost:8080`

## Rate Limits
- OTP Request: 3 requests per 5 seconds (IP-based)
- OTP Verify: 3 requests per 5 seconds (mobile-based)
- Admin Login: 5 requests per 10 seconds (IP-based)
- Global: 100 requests per 200 seconds (IP-based)

item.name: Auth — User
item.description: User authentication via OTP (SMS). New users are auto-registered on first verify.

request.description:
Sends an OTP to the user's mobile number via SMS.

**Auth**: API Key only (no JWT)
**Rate Limit**: 3 per 5s (IP-based)
**Validation**: Mobile must match `^[6-9]\d{9}$` (Indian 10-digit)

**Request Fields**:
- `mobile` (required): 10-digit Indian mobile number
- `app_signature` (optional): Android app signature for auto-read
- `device_id` (optional): Device identifier
- `device_name` (optional): Device name

response.name: Rate Limited

request.description:
Verifies the OTP and returns JWT access + refresh tokens. Creates user if new.

**Auth**: API Key only
**Rate Limit**: 3 per 5s (mobile-based)

**Request Fields**:
- `mobile` (required): 10-digit Indian mobile
- `otp` (required): 6-digit OTP
- `name` (required for new users): User's display name
- `referral_code` (optional): Referral code from another user/driver
- `device_id` (optional): Device identifier
- `device_name` (optional): Device name

response.name: Name Required

item.name: Rides
item.description: Full ride lifecycle: request, accept, arrive, start, complete, cancel.

request.description:
Creates a new ride request and triggers driver matching.

**Auth**: JWT (role: user)
**Validation**:
- `pickup_lat/lng`, `dropoff_lat/lng`: required, valid lat/lng ranges
- `pickup_address`, `drop_address`: required
- `payment_mode`: optional, one of `cash` | `online` (default: `cash`)
- `amb_type_id`: optional (empty = Book Any)
- `hospital_id`: optional
- `is_sos`: optional boolean

Driver accepts an offered ride.

**Auth**: JWT (role: driver)
**Path Params**: `id` — Ride ObjectID

Driver marks arrival at pickup. Only the assigned driver can call this.

**Auth**: JWT (role: driver)

Driver starts the ride after OTP verification.

**Auth**: JWT (role: driver)
**Fields**: `otp` or `user_otp` (required if ambulance type has OTP enabled)

Driver completes the ride. Creates payment record, calculates fare.

**Auth**: JWT (role: driver)
**Fields**: `drop_address` (optional), `payment_mode` (optional, default: cash)

Cancels a ride. Both users and drivers can cancel.

**Auth**: JWT (any role — user or driver)
**Business Logic**: Cancel reason auto-determined (user_cancelled, driver_cancelled, user_cancelled_before_assignment)

Returns ride history for the authenticated user or driver.

**Auth**: JWT (any role)
**Query Params**: `limit` (default 10), `skip` (default 0)

Returns the current active ride for the user/driver. Optionally pass `ride_id` to fetch a specific ride.

**Auth**: JWT (any role)

User fetches assigned driver's profile during an active ride.

**Auth**: JWT (any role, ownership enforced)
**Required**: `ride_id`

Driver fetches the ride requester's profile.

**Auth**: JWT (any role, ownership enforced)
**Required**: `ride_id`

**Auth**: JWT (any role)
**Required**: `distance_km` (must be > 0)
**Optional**: `amb_type_id` (empty = all types), `is_sos`
